integrity: Analytical derivations are separated from finite rational and simulation checks. Source priority is reported as best-knowledge, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The new theorem is the normalized random-brightness distribution and interior logarithmic caustic for the non-axial cubic h(u)=1+epsilon*u1*u2*u3 under a Haar direction, not the previously published pointwise brightness formula or convexity threshold. The full Abas manuscript was not materially read; priority beyond the inspected literature remains uncertain. The theorem does not apply to arbitrary convex bodies or establish inverse uniqueness.
title: An interior logarithmic caustic in random brightness of the cubic threefold-projection body
